title: Settings — Discussion
description: Standalone Discussion-settings panel: default comment + ping status over the REST settings surface.

documentation.purpose: DataForm over the REST-exposed slice of WordPress's Discussion Settings: `default_comment_status` + `default_ping_status` — the canonical 'Default post settings' pair (mapped open/closed ↔ boolean). Reads + writes through `core-data` `useEntityRecord('root','site')` via the shared `EntityDataForm`. Composable host (`core:settings`) mounts this for the `discussion` panel; shells mount it directly as a Discussion screen.

interactions.trigger: Toggle allow comments on new posts

interactions.effect: `await save()`; success snackbar / error notice via `useEntitySave`.

a11y.focus-management: Native DataForm focus order is sufficient.

constraints.note: `default_comment_status` / `default_ping_status` round-trip as `open`/`closed` strings; the boolean control maps both ways via getValue/setValue.
Fine-grained discussion rules (moderation, blocklists, avatars) are not exposed by `/wp/v2/settings`. The panel renders an in-form notice pointing at the legacy `options-discussion.php` screen.
